Senior Business Analyst | Product Owner with 12+ years of IT experience, including 8+ years in Business Analysis, Agile Delivery, Product Development, and Enterprise System Integration across EdTech, Academic Operations, BFSI, Wealth Management, Insurance, P&C and Superannuation domains. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering web, mobile, cloud-based, and enterprise applications from concept through design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and business adoption. Deep expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and the preparation of high-quality BRDs, FRDs/FSDs, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications. Experienced in translating complex business requirements into scalable, customer-centric solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem, Mulesoft, Mendix, Sonata / Guidewire PolicyCenter, ServiceNow implementations, API integrations, and enterprise cloud platforms for global clients across the UK, USA, Singapore, ANZ, Europe, China, and UAE. Experienced in backlog management, product delivery, Agile methodologies, enterprise transformation, and large-scale system implementations. Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentforce, AI Agents, and intelligent automation, leveraging emerging technologies to streamline processes, enhance decision-making, accelerate delivery timelines, and drive continuous improvement. Recognized for delivering high-quality solutions, leading testing, release management, production support, and building strong stakeholder relationships to achieve measurable business value.
